description: Verify an inbound webhook HMAC signature against the raw body and secret, and flag a replay-window breach. At the start of a webhook handler, before acting on the event. Do not choose this when the sender uses a public-key scheme, which needs its key. Example requests: Verify this webhook signature before I trust the event. | Is this webhook payload authentic? | Check this Stripe/GitHub webhook signature. | Did this webhook come from the real sender?

accepted_price.description: The amount accepted, exactly as quoted (for example "5.00" or 5). Checked against the stored quote, so a price that moved between quote and authorize is refused rather than silently absorbed. Optional, but sent to make the acceptance explicit.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

headers.description: The customer's headers.txt, as text. Supported: Plain text. The request headers, one 'Name: value' per line. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

payload.description: The customer's payload.json, as text. Supported: Text. The raw request body. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

secret.description: The customer's secret.txt, as text. Supported: Text. The signing secret. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

quote_id.description: The quote_id returned by POST /v1/jobs. Required to authorize a priced capability; the service rejects a priced job that does not name the quote it issued.

name: submit_webhook_signature_verify

access_token.description: Per-job credential. Present it as the X-Job-Token header to read the job or list it. Keep it; it is the only credential for this job.

verification.description: Independent verification. verification.ok = false means the job failed, not a partial success.

title: Webhook signature verification
